## Load Packages
```{r}
#Clear environment
rm(list = ls())

library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
```


## Read in the Data
```{r}
# Load CSV
sites <- read.csv("../data/DUG_data - fall_data.csv")

# Standardize Paths (Using your relative data folder)
imperv_path <- "../data/NLCD_mf5qnksxr8tzfi/Annual_NLCD_FctImp_2024_CU_C1V1_mf5qnksxr8tzfi.tiff"
tcc_path    <- "../data/NLCD_mf5qnksxr8tzfi/nlcd_tcc_conus_wgs84_v2023-5_20230101_20231231_mf5qnksxr8tzfi.tiff"

# Load rasters directly into a unified SpatRaster stack 
rasters <- rast(c(tcc_path, imperv_path))
names(rasters) <- c("tcc", "imperv")
```

## Extract Raster Data

Prepare spatial datapoints
```{r}
# Convert CSV points into a SpatVector
sites_spatial <- vect(sites, geom = c("Long", "Lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

# Re-project point vectors to match the Raster projection
sites_projected <- project(sites_spatial, crs(rasters))
```

### Extract Continuous Variables (TCC and IMP)
```{r}
buffer_radius <- c(200, 500, 1000)

# Create a copy of our data frame to hold all our metrics
sites_output <- sites

for (r in buffer_radius) {
  # Generate buffers natively in terra (meters units matching NLCD CRS)
  site_buffers <- terra::buffer(sites_projected, width = r)
  
  # Extract means for TCC and Impervious simultaneously
  extracted_means <- terra::extract(rasters[[c("tcc", "imperv")]], site_buffers, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Assign clean dynamic column names
  tcc_col <- paste0("tcc_", r, "m")
  imp_col <- paste0("imp_", r, "m")
  
  sites_output[[tcc_col]] <- extracted_means$tcc
  sites_output[[imp_col]] <- extracted_means$imperv
}

print(sites_output)
```

## Extract Categorical Variables (Land Cover Class Proportions)
Reclassify nlcd raster and assign categories
```{r}
nlcd_map <- rast("../data/NLCD_mf5qnt9vt9mx4o/Annual_NLCD_LndCov_2024_CU_C1V1_mf5qnt9vt9mx4o.tiff")

#Build lookup table
lookup_table <- tibble(
  ID = 1:nrow(sites_projected),
  site_code = as.character(sites_projected$site_code)
)

buffer_sizes <- c(200, 500, 1000)

extract_nlcd_buffer <- function(buffer_m, points, raster_file) {
  
  # Generate local buffers
  buffers_vect <- terra::buffer(points, width = buffer_m)
  
  # Force terra to return raw cell numbers (11, 21, etc.)
  raw_extract <- terra::extract(raster_file, buffers_vect, raw = TRUE)
  
  # FIX: Convert the raw matrix into a standard data frame so we can name the columns!
  raw_extract_df <- as.data.frame(raw_extract)
  names(raw_extract_df) <- c("ID", "pixel_value")
  
  # Run your exact matching rules
  raw_extract_df %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    left_join(lookup_table, by = "ID") %>%
    mutate(
      lc_group = case_when(
        pixel_value == 11 ~ "water",
        pixel_value %in% c(21, 22) ~ "dev_low",
        pixel_value %in% c(23, 24) ~ "dev_high",
        pixel_value %in% c(41, 42, 43) ~ "forest",
        pixel_value %in% c(52, 71) ~ "shrub_grass",
        pixel_value %in% c(81, 82) ~ "agriculture",
        pixel_value %in% c(90, 95) ~ "wetland",
        pixel_value == 31 ~ "barren",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(lc_group)) %>%
    count(site_code, lc_group) %>%
    group_by(site_code) %>%
    mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(buffer_label = paste0(lc_group, "_", buffer_m, "m")) %>%
    dplyr::select(site_code, buffer_label, prop)
}

# 4. Run loop across your buffer sizes
landcover_all <- map_dfr(buffer_sizes, ~ extract_nlcd_buffer(.x, sites_projected, nlcd_map))

# 5. Pivot sideways 
landcover_wide <- landcover_all %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = buffer_label, values_from = prop, values_fill = 0)

# 6. Join back to your main site metrics
final_data <- left_join(sites_output, landcover_wide, by = "site_code")
```

#Final Dataframe
```{r}
print(final_data)
```

Save updated sites dataframe as csv
```{r}
write.csv(final_data,"../data/DUG_sites.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
